::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this task achieves

Use this route to make a focused, tested and reviewable change to maintained
BNR code or configuration.

## Before you start

- Define the problem, intended change and successful test.
- Identify the maintained source file and every affected workflow.
- Agree changes to methods, disclosure rules or responsibilities before coding.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
Agree the change → work on a focused branch → change and test the maintained
source → review and merge → check the resulting workflow or website.
:::

## Complete the following steps

| Order | Manual | Task | Detailed guidance |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Operations]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--operations} | **Confirm authority for a material operating change** — responsible owner; affected roles; approval or publication boundary; agreed outcome | Use [Roles and decision rights](../../operations/operating-model/roles-decision-rights.qmd) and agree consequential changes with the BNR Lead before coding. |
| 2 | [Public Methods]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--methods} | **Agree any change to public statistical meaning** — definition; calculation; interpretation; limitation; comparability | Review and update the relevant [Public Methods page](../../methods/index.qmd) whenever the implemented public method changes. |
| 3 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Complete the controlled code-change route** — current `main`; focused branch; maintained source; exact diff; proportionate tests; dependent documentation; pull-request review and merge | Follow [Make a safe code change](../maintenance/safe-code-change.qmd). Never test by editing a generated output. |
| 4 | [Technical]{.bnr-manual-label .bnr-manual-label--technical} | **Check the changed system after merge** — affected analytical workflow, utility or full website; expected result; no unintended public or private files | Use the completion checks in the [safe-code-change procedure](../maintenance/safe-code-change.qmd#step-9-review-and-merge) and, for website changes, confirm the live deployment. |

## How to confirm completion

The required tests pass, the reviewed pull request is merged, dependent
documentation is current, and the affected workflow or website behaves as agreed.
